english_source_note: Kronecker's Theorem, Dirichlet's Theorem, and Applications
statement_en: For an irrational number $\alpha$ and any $\varepsilon>0$, there exists a positive integer $q_{\varepsilon}$ such that $$||q_{\varepsilon}\alpha||<\varepsilon.$$
callout_body: 对于无理数$\alpha$以及任意的$\varepsilon>0$存在正整数$q_{\varepsilon}$使得$$||q_{\varepsilon}\alpha||<\varepsilon$$
